summary: A future at Quote on Groww's F&O price subject: OHLC and volume come through; Groww's price message carries no open interest, so none is sent.

notes: The fake socket does not echo the nats subprotocol, so each connect is two connections: the first asks for it and is dropped by the feed, the second goes without it (GrowwFeed::on_connect_failed, web nats_websocket.py subprotocol fallback). Connection 2 is the session.

The socket token comes from the fake broker API (env.serve_json in tests/it/feed_corpus/groww.rs, GrowwBroker::with_feed_endpoints). INFO carries no nonce, so CONNECT is the jwt-only form; the signed form is pinned by tests/it/broker_groww_feed.rs, which checks the nonce signature.

deviations.reason: The web's Groww adapter writes its publish bookkeeping into data (broker, its ZeroMQ topic, subscription_mode) and the proxy forwards it. Lead decision: carry it as a Groww alias, or declare it a desktop decision (the frame's top-level broker already names the broker).

The web sends Groww's tsInMillis as the protobuf double it decodes, a float (1730790000000.0); feed timestamps are integer epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the integer.
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The web forwards Groww's traded value (`value`, rupees) in Quote and Depth; the desktop decodes it (brokers/groww/proto.rs StocksLivePrice.value) but the common tick has no field for it. Carrier gap for lane wire.
The web sends Groww's volume as the protobuf double it decodes, a float (1200000.0); volume is an integer (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md). The desktop sends the integer.
